description: Authenticates a school's domain so AVA (ava.applicaa.ai) can send email from it through SendGrid: return-path and DKIM CNAMEs, link branding CNAMEs and an AVA ownership TXT. No MX, SPF or DMARC changes. Group 'auth' is always applied; group 'link' when link branding is enabled.
variableDescription: returnId: digits of the SendGrid return-path label em<digits>; sgTarget: SendGrid account target without .sendgrid.net (e.g. u1234567.wl123); ownershipToken: 32 hex chars issued by AVA; linkId: digits of the SendGrid link branding label url<digits>; ownerId: numeric SendGrid link owner label.
